item.title: Quarterly Report - FY26 Q1, July - September 2025
item.description: Quarterly Report - FY26 Q1, July - September 2025

item.title: Calling All Volunteers: Help Put Stroll on State “Back in the Box” for 2026
item.description: GoRockford and partners are gearing up to put Stroll on State’s and Downtown Holiday Decorations “Back in the Box”.

item.title: Rockford to Host 2026 Baseball For All Nationals
item.description: GoRockford, Baseball For All, and the Rockford Park District are proud to announce that the Rockford region will host the 11th annual Baseball For All (BFA) Nationals July 19–25, 2026, during the same week as the WBSC Women’s Baseball World Cup group stage.

item.title: GoRockford & UMB Bank Announce New Three-Year Presenting Partnership for Stroll on State
item.description: GoRockford announced today a new three-year presenting partnership with UMB Bank for Stroll on State, securing the future of the beloved holiday festival through 2026, 2027, and 2028.

item.title: Rockford Restaurant Week Returns with a Record 80 Participating Restaurants
item.description: Rockford Restaurant Week, presented by GoRockford, returns for its sixth year from Thursday, January 29 to Sunday, February 8, celebrating and showcasing the region’s diverse and growing culinary scene.

item.title: 2026 IHSA Girls Bowling State Finals Back in Rockford
item.description: GoRockford and The Cherry Bowl are pleased to welcome back the Illinois High School Association (IHSA) for the 2026 IHSA Girls Bowling State Finals.

item.title: Rockford Restaurant Week Celebrates 2026 “Best Of” Winners
item.description: GoRockford proudly announces the recipients of the 2026 Rockford Restaurant Week “Best of” Awards and celebrates another record-breaking year for the annual culinary promotion.

item.title: Final Round of Restaurant Relief Grant Distributes $427,000 to Local Restaurants
item.description: GoRockford announced an additional $427,631.17 in state funding awarded to area restaurants in the fifth and final round of its Restaurant Relief Grant Program, helping businesses continue to recover from elevated unemployment insurance taxes resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic.

item.title: IHSA Selects Rockford to Host Boys Soccer State Finals
item.description: GoRockford and the Rockford Public Schools District 205 and Guilford High School are pleased to announce that Rockford has been selected to host the Illinois High School Association (IHSA) Boys Soccer State Finals for the next three years.

item.title: Second Annual Animal Rescue Expo Returns to Rockford
item.description: GoRockford and Rockford Park District are pleased to welcome back the Animal Rescue Expo to Rockford. This charitable pet expo, hosted by Lisa’s Little Rescue, will bring approximately 1,000 attendees.

item.title: Call for Applications, Events, and Student Art & Essay Entries for Rockford Region’s America 250 Celebrations
item.description: Local organizations, artists, students, and community members are invited to take part in the nationwide America 250 celebration, commemorating the United States’ 250th anniversary in 2026.

item.title: GoRockford Opens Nominations for 2026 Hospitality Hero Awards
item.description: GoRockford is now accepting nominations for its annual Hospitality Hero Awards, recognizing outstanding individuals in the region’s hospitality industry who go above and beyond to deliver exceptional visitor experiences.
